title: loguploader-service semantic data dictionary — semantic-model.json
description: Format of docs/data-dictionary/semantic-model.json: a flat map of dot-namespaced concept id -> concept entry, shared across every spec in this repo that produces output data (constitution Principle VII; originated by spec 002's FR-036-FR-040, D15). Structural sibling: each spec's own contracts/*.schema.json describes document SHAPE; this describes concept MEANING, once, for the whole repo.

id.description: same dot-namespaced id as the property key; kept explicit for grep/diff friendliness

unit.description: e.g. milliseconds, bytes; null where the value is not a measured quantity

description.description: what the concept MEANS, not what shape it has

aliases.description: other field names this same concept appears under across documents

parent.description: enclosing concept id for a nested field, e.g. telemetry.os.arch -> telemetry.os

examples.description: at least one real or realistic example value

confidence.description: uncertain unless checked against specs/003-backend-api-support or working code (FR-037)
